description: Ministry of Tourism and Land - The recommendation of the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority as a Tourist Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring certain areas as Tourist Development Areas under the Tourism Act. The core content focuses on land identification (listing specific Grama Niladhari Divisions and their extents in hectares) for the purpose of tourism development. While a government minister is named, the announcement is not about his appointment or the restructuring of his ministry; it is an exercise of his statutory power to make a declaration about land use. Therefore, the specialized Land classification (Type 4) takes precedence over the government personnel classification.
